I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is **#8841**.

- **Where it came from:** Tobias posted in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27) that West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on ticket #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could see it herself.
- **Not confirmed:** Tobias said it was on "his dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. I made the link from a team digest dated Jan 2: it calls Marrow Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it changes hands on Jan 5, 2026. It doesn't say who takes it over, so Tobias having it is my guess. I said this in the reply and suggested she check with Tobias before the call, in case support has updated the ticket.
- **Similar number:** I warned her not to mix it up with #88412, an older Tansleigh Packaging ticket that came up in #central-team.

I only read channels Pree is in and public files, and didn't use message search.
